carousels.heading: gifts she'll keep forever
carousels.caption: Sentimental girlfriends do not need a bigger gift—they need proof you remembered. Pick one photo, one inside joke, and one tiny artifact from your relationship. Save this for her birthday or your anniversary. #giftideas #girlfriendgift #sentimentalgift #diygift #giftinspo

carousels.heading: the gift basket formula
carousels.caption: A good gift basket is not six random pink things. Use this formula: 1 anchor hobby + 1 daily upgrade + 1 comfort item + 1 plan to enjoy it. Save it before the next birthday panic. #giftbasket #giftideasforher #girlfriendgift #giftguide #giftinspo

carousels.heading: make a small gift feel special
carousels.caption: The difference between cheap and thoughtful is presentation plus specificity. Use one palette, create multiple small reveals, add handwriting, and finish with an inside callback. Save this before you wrap your next gift. #giftwrapping #giftideas #budgetgift #diygift #giftinspo
